decode.timing_scope: decode_cloud only, alternating per-message order; no deserialization or comparison cost
limitations: Only recorded layouts/transforms exercised; no generated layout cases.
No safety/accuracy claim or target hardware measurement.
Retained-array bytes report the peak over measured frames, not a cumulative allocation or resident-set cost.
Attribute availability is reported as measured; firing identity and return multiplicity are not inferred.

before.accuracy_validity: No ground truth implied by bag name or alarm count
before.latency_scope: Offline iteration: bag read/deserialization/decode, inference, optional diagnostic/RViz-bag writes, result JSON serialization and buffered write. Excludes timing-log write, fsync, live DDS queues/transport and viewer rendering; not sensor-to-display age. With prefetch_depth > 0 the read/deserialization/decode of the next scan runs on one producer thread while inference runs on this one, so read_and_process_ms is the cost of one loop iteration, not the age of a decision: a scan still waits for the scan ahead of it to finish. Wall_s / frames is the throughput that overlap buys.

Temporal hits unchanged; existing spatial voxel support is not a count of independent firings.
Deskew remains disabled; timing and mounting unverified.
Detector panel is 12 development frames, all frame statuses no_obstacle_observed and objects adjacent; no hazard recall/safety validation.

Decoder panel is first eight messages from each of seven real recordings; all measured channels present and finite. Missing/invalid attribute UI was not exercised against a real recording with those conditions.
One-row little-endian recordings only; no synthetic layouts included in acceptance.
No ROS2 runtime or target Intel CPU verification.
Workers ran out-of-contract synthetic/ad-hoc probes; these are excluded from acceptance. No automated test files/framework introduced.
